+import XCTest
+
+final class GhosttyTabSidebarUITests: GhosttyCustomConfigCase {
+    /// Use a separate defaults suite so the sidebar width/visibility of the
+    /// other UI tests doesn't affect these.
+    private let defaultsSuite = "GHOSTTY_UI_TESTS_TAB_SIDEBAR"
+
+    override func setUp() async throws {
+        try await super.setUp()
+        UserDefaults(suiteName: defaultsSuite)?.removePersistentDomain(forName: defaultsSuite)
+        try updateConfig(
+            """
+            title = "GhosttyTabSidebarUITests"
+            confirm-close-surface = false
+            """
+        )
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    private func launch() throws -> XCUIApplication {
+        let app = try ghosttyApplication(defaultsSuite: defaultsSuite)
+        app.launch()
+        XCTAssertTrue(app.windows.firstMatch.waitForExistence(timeout: 2), "Main window should exist")
+        return app
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    private func sidebar(_ app: XCUIApplication) -> XCUIElement {
+        app.windows.firstMatch.tables["TabSidebar"]
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    private func waitForRowCount(_ app: XCUIApplication, _ count: Int) -> Bool {
+        let expectation = XCTNSPredicateExpectation(
+            predicate: NSPredicate(format: "count == %d", count),
+            object: sidebar(app).tableRows)
+        return XCTWaiter.wait(for: [expectation], timeout: 2) == .completed
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    private func newTab(_ app: XCUIApplication) {
+        app.windows.firstMatch.groups["Terminal pane"].typeKey("t", modifierFlags: .command)
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    func testSidebarListsTabs() throws {
+        let app = try launch()
+        XCTAssertTrue(sidebar(app).waitForExistence(timeout: 1), "Tab sidebar should exist")
+        XCTAssertEqual(sidebar(app).tableRows.count, 1, "A single tab should still be listed")
+
+        newTab(app)
+        newTab(app)
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 3))
+
+        // The native tab bar must not be visible.
+        XCTAssertEqual(app.windows.firstMatch.tabs.count, 0, "Native tabs should be hidden")
+        XCTAssertTrue(sidebar(app).staticTexts["⌘1"].exists, "Shortcut hints should be shown")
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    func testNewTabButton() throws {
+        let app = try launch()
+        app.windows.firstMatch.buttons["TabSidebarNewTabButton"].click()
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 2))
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    func testCloseButton() throws {
+        let app = try launch()
+        newTab(app)
+        newTab(app)
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 3))
+
+        let row = sidebar(app).tableRows.element(boundBy: 1)
+        row.hover()
+        row.buttons["TabSidebarCloseButton"].click()
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 2))
+    }

+    func testRenameInline() throws {

+        newTab(app)
+
+        let row = sidebar(app).tableRows.element(boundBy: 1)

+        XCTAssertEqual(app.windows.firstMatch.title, "Renamed Tab")

+    }

+    func testRenameLongTitle() throws {
+        let app = try launch()
+        sidebar(app).tableRows.element(boundBy: 0).doubleClick()
+        let editor = sidebar(app).textFields.firstMatch
+        XCTAssertTrue(editor.waitForExistence(timeout: 1))

+        XCTAssertTrue(editor.waitForExistence(timeout: 1))

+    func testContextMenuCloseOtherTabs() throws {
+        let app = try launch()
+        newTab(app)
+        newTab(app)
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 3))
+
+        sidebar(app).tableRows.element(boundBy: 0).rightClick()
+        app.menuItems["Close Other Tabs"].click()
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 1))

+    func testToggleSidebar() throws {

+        XCTAssertTrue(sidebar(app).waitForExistence(timeout: 1))
+
+        app.typeKey("b", modifierFlags: [.command, .shift])
+        XCTAssertFalse(sidebar(app).isHittable, "Sidebar should be hidden")

+        XCTAssertTrue(sidebar(app).waitForExistence(timeout: 1))
+        XCTAssertTrue(sidebar(app).isHittable, "Sidebar should be visible again")
+    }

+    @MainActor
+    func testDragReorder() throws {
+        let app = try launch()
+        newTab(app)
+        newTab(app)
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 3))
+
+        // Rename the last tab so we can find it after moving.

+        last.doubleClick()
+        app.typeText("Moved\n")
+        XCTAssertTrue(sidebar(app).staticTexts["Moved"].waitForExistence(timeout: 1))

+        last.press(forDuration: 0.3, thenDragTo: sidebar(app).tableRows.element(boundBy: 0))

+        let first = sidebar(app).tableRows.element(boundBy: 0)
+        XCTAssertTrue(first.staticTexts["Moved"].waitForExistence(timeout: 1), "Dragged tab should be first")
+    }

+    @MainActor
+    func testHiddenTitlebarAllowsTabs() throws {
+        try updateConfig(
+            """
+            macos-titlebar-style = hidden
+            title = "GhosttyTabSidebarUITests"
+            """

+        newTab(app)
+        XCTAssertTrue(waitForRowCount(app, 2))
+        XCTAssertEqual(app.windows.count, 1, "New tabs should not open new windows")
+    }

+import Foundation
+import UniformTypeIdentifiers
+
+/// A file or directory listed in the file explorer.
+struct FileExplorerEntry: Equatable {
+    let url: URL
+    let name: String
+
+    /// True for directories we can expand. Packages (e.g. `.app`) are treated as files.
+    let isDirectory: Bool
+    let isHidden: Bool
+}
+
+/// Pure logic used by the file explorer and the file preview. This is kept free of
+/// AppKit state so it can be unit tested.
+enum FileExplorerLogic {
+    /// The minimum width the user can resize the file preview to.
+    static let previewMinWidth: CGFloat = 240
+
+    /// The maximum width the user can resize the file preview to.
+    static let previewMaxWidth: CGFloat = 1200
+
+    /// The width of the file preview if the user never resized it.
+    static let previewDefaultWidth: CGFloat = 480
+
+    /// Text files larger than this are not previewed as text.
+    static let maxTextPreviewBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024
+
+    /// How many bytes we look at to decide if a file is binary.
+    static let sniffBytes = 8 * 1024
+
+    // MARK: Listing
+
+    /// Lists the entries of a directory, directories first. Returns an empty list if the
+    /// directory can't be read.
+    static func listDirectory(_ url: URL, showHidden: Bool) -> [FileExplorerEntry] {
+        let keys: [URLResourceKey] = [.isDirectoryKey, .isPackageKey, .isHiddenKey]
+        guard let urls = try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
+            at: url,
+            includingPropertiesForKeys: keys,
+            options: []
+        ) else { return [] }
+
+        let entries = urls.compactMap { url -> FileExplorerEntry? in
+            let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: Set(keys))
+            let name = url.lastPathComponent
+            let isHidden = values?.isHidden ?? name.hasPrefix(".")
+            if isHidden && !showHidden { return nil }
+            let isDirectory = (values?.isDirectory ?? false) && !(values?.isPackage ?? false)
+            return FileExplorerEntry(url: url, name: name, isDirectory: isDirectory, isHidden: isHidden)
+        }
+
+        return sort(entries)
+    }
+
+    /// Sorts entries like Finder: directories first, then by name.
+    static func sort(_ entries: [FileExplorerEntry]) -> [FileExplorerEntry] {
+        entries.sorted { lhs, rhs in
+            if lhs.isDirectory != rhs.isDirectory { return lhs.isDirectory }
+            return lhs.name.localizedStandardCompare(rhs.name) == .orderedAscending
+        }
+    }
+
+    // MARK: Preview
+
+    /// How a file is shown in the file preview.
+    enum PreviewKind: Equatable {
+        /// Shown as plain text.
+        case text
+
+        /// Shown with Quick Look (images, PDFs, binaries, ...).
+        case quickLook
+
+        /// A text file that is too large to show.
+        case tooLarge
+    }
+
+    /// Decides how to preview the file at the given URL.
+    static func previewKind(for url: URL, maxTextBytes: Int = maxTextPreviewBytes) -> PreviewKind {
+        if let type = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension),
+           [.image, .pdf, .audiovisualContent, .font].contains(where: { type.conforms(to: $0) }) {
+            return .quickLook
+        }
+
+        guard let handle = try? FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url) else { return .quickLook }
+        defer { try? handle.close() }
+        let head = (try? handle.read(upToCount: sniffBytes)) ?? Data()
+        if head.contains(0) { return .quickLook }
+
+        let size = (try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.fileSizeKey]))?.fileSize ?? 0
+        return size > maxTextBytes ? .tooLarge : .text
+    }
+
+    /// Reads a text file, guessing the encoding if it isn't UTF-8.
+    static func readText(_ url: URL) -> String? {
+        if let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url), let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) {
+            return text
+        }
+
+        var encoding = String.Encoding.utf8
+        return try? String(contentsOf: url, usedEncoding: &encoding)
+    }
+
+    // MARK: Layout
+
+    /// Clamps a stored (user-chosen) preview width into the valid range.
+    static func clampPreviewWidth(_ width: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
+        guard width.isFinite else { return previewDefaultWidth }
+        return min(max(width, previewMinWidth), previewMaxWidth)
+    }
+
+    /// The width actually laid out for the preview, given the width available for both the
+    /// terminal and the preview. The terminal keeps at least its minimum width.
+    static func effectivePreviewWidth(stored: CGFloat, available: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
+        let width = clampPreviewWidth(stored)
+        let room = available - TabSidebarLogic.minTerminalWidth
+        return max(0, min(width, room))
+    }
+}

+import AppKit
+import Combine
+
+/// A file or directory in the file explorer tree. Directory children are loaded lazily the
+/// first time the directory is expanded.
+final class FileExplorerNode {
+    private(set) var entry: FileExplorerEntry
+
+    /// The children of a directory, nil until they are loaded.
+    var children: [FileExplorerNode]?
+
+    var url: URL { entry.url }
+
+    init(entry: FileExplorerEntry) {
+        self.entry = entry
+    }
+
+    func update(entry: FileExplorerEntry) {
+        self.entry = entry
+    }
+}
+
+/// A Warp-style file explorer listing the working directory of the focused terminal of a
+/// tab. It is shown in the tab sidebar when the sidebar is in files mode.
+///
+/// The tree root follows the working directory and the loaded directories are watched
+/// with FSEvents so the tree stays up to date.
+final class FileExplorerView: NSView {
+    /// The controller of the window that hosts this explorer.
+    private weak var controller: TerminalController?
+
+    private let pathField: NSTextField = {
+        let field = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
+        field.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12, weight: .semibold)
+        field.textColor = .labelColor
+        field.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingMiddle
+        field.setContentCompressionResistancePriority(.defaultLow, for: .horizontal)
+        field.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
+        field.setAccessibilityIdentifier("FileExplorerPath")
+        return field
+    }()
+
+    private lazy var finderButton = makeButton(
+        symbol: "folder",
+        toolTip: "Open in Finder",
+        identifier: "FileExplorerFinderButton",
+        action: #selector(openRootInFinder(_:)))
+
+    private lazy var hiddenButton = makeButton(
+        symbol: "eye.slash",
+        toolTip: "Show Hidden Files",
+        identifier: "FileExplorerHiddenButton",
+        action: #selector(toggleHiddenFiles(_:)))
+
+    private lazy var refreshButton = makeButton(
+        symbol: "arrow.clockwise",
+        toolTip: "Refresh",
+        identifier: "FileExplorerRefreshButton",
+        action: #selector(refresh(_:)))
+
+    private let scrollView = NSScrollView()
+    private let outlineView = FileExplorerOutlineView()
+
+    private let emptyField: NSTextField = {
+        let field = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
+        field.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12)
+        field.textColor = .secondaryLabelColor
+        field.alignment = .center
+        field.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
+        return field
+    }()
+
+    /// The root of the tree: the working directory, with its symlinks resolved so paths
+    /// match the paths reported by FSEvents.
+    private var root: FileExplorerNode?
+
+    /// The paths of the expanded directories, so expansion survives reloads.
+    private var expandedPaths: Set<String> = []
+
+    /// True when the directory changed while the window wasn't visible.
+    private var needsReload = false
+
+    private lazy var watcher = FileExplorerWatcher { [weak self] paths in
+        self?.directoriesDidChange(paths)
+    }
+
+    private var cancellables: Set<AnyCancellable> = []
+
+    init(controller: TerminalController) {
+        self.controller = controller
+        super.init(frame: .zero)
+        setup()
+    }
+
+    @available(*, unavailable)
+    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
+        fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented")
+    }
+
+    // MARK: Setup
+
+    private func setup() {
+        setAccessibilityIdentifier("FileExplorer")
+
+        let buttons = NSStackView(views: [hiddenButton, refreshButton, finderButton])
+        buttons.orientation = .horizontal
+        buttons.spacing = 2
+        buttons.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
+        buttons.setContentHuggingPriority(.required, for: .horizontal)
+        addSubview(pathField)
+        addSubview(buttons)
+
+        // The column always spans the visible width, see `syncColumnWidth`.
+        let column = NSTableColumn(identifier: .init("file"))
+        column.resizingMask = []
+        column.minWidth = 0
+        column.maxWidth = .greatestFiniteMagnitude
+        outlineView.addTableColumn(column)
+        outlineView.outlineTableColumn = column
+        outlineView.headerView = nil
+        outlineView.rowHeight = 22
+        outlineView.indentationPerLevel = 14
+        outlineView.backgroundColor = .clear
+        outlineView.style = .plain
+        outlineView.columnAutoresizingStyle = .noColumnAutoresizing
+        outlineView.autoresizesOutlineColumn = false
+        outlineView.dataSource = self
+        outlineView.delegate = self
+        outlineView.target = self
+        outlineView.action = #selector(rowClicked(_:))
+        outlineView.doubleAction = #selector(rowDoubleClicked(_:))
+        outlineView.setDraggingSourceOperationMask(.copy, forLocal: false)
+        outlineView.setAccessibilityIdentifier("FileExplorerTree")
+
+        let menu = NSMenu()
+        menu.delegate = self
+        outlineView.menu = menu
+
+        scrollView.documentView = outlineView
+        scrollView.hasVerticalScroller = true
+        scrollView.autohidesScrollers = true
+        scrollView.drawsBackground = false
+        scrollView.borderType = .noBorder
+        scrollView.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
+        addSubview(scrollView)
+        addSubview(emptyField)
+
+        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([

+/// Watches a directory tree with FSEvents and reports the directories in which something
+/// changed. Events are delivered on the main queue.
+final class FileExplorerWatcher {
+    /// Called with the paths (without a trailing slash) of the directories that changed.
+    private let onChange: ([String]) -> Void
+
+    private var stream: FSEventStreamRef?
+
+    /// The path being watched, if any.
+    private(set) var path: String?
+
+    init(onChange: @escaping ([String]) -> Void) {
+        self.onChange = onChange
+    }
+
+    deinit {
+        stop()
+    }
+
+    /// Starts watching the given directory tree, replacing any previous one.
+    func start(path: String) {
+        guard path != self.path || stream == nil else { return }
+        stop()
+
+        var context = FSEventStreamContext(
+            version: 0,
+            info: Unmanaged.passUnretained(self).toOpaque(),
+            retain: nil,
+            release: nil,
+            copyDescription: nil)
+
+        let callback: FSEventStreamCallback = { _, info, count, paths, _, _ in
+            guard let info else { return }
+            let watcher = Unmanaged<FileExplorerWatcher>.fromOpaque(info).takeUnretainedValue()
+            let paths = unsafeBitCast(paths, to: NSArray.self) as? [String] ?? []
+            watcher.onChange(Array(paths.prefix(count)).map { path in
+                path.count > 1 && path.hasSuffix("/") ? String(path.dropLast()) : path
+            })
+        }
+
+        guard let stream = FSEventStreamCreate(
+            kCFAllocatorDefault,
+            callback,
+            &context,
+            [path] as CFArray,
+            FSEventStreamEventId(kFSEventStreamEventIdSinceNow),
+            0.3,
+            FSEventStreamCreateFlags(kFSEventStreamCreateFlagUseCFTypes | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagWatchRoot)
+        ) else { return }
+
+        FSEventStreamSetDispatchQueue(stream, .main)
+        guard FSEventStreamStart(stream) else {
+            FSEventStreamInvalidate(stream)
+            FSEventStreamRelease(stream)
+            return
+        }
+
+        self.stream = stream
+        self.path = path
+    }
+
+    /// Stops watching.
+    func stop() {
+        path = nil
+        guard let stream else { return }
+        FSEventStreamStop(stream)
+        FSEventStreamInvalidate(stream)
+        FSEventStreamRelease(stream)
+        self.stream = nil
+    }
+}

+/// A thin handle on the edge of a pane that resizes it. By default it sits on the trailing
+/// edge of the tab sidebar and stores the width in the shared `TabSidebarSettings` so all

+final class TabSidebarResizeHandle: NSView {
+    /// The edge of the resized pane the handle sits on.

+        case trailing
+    }
+
+    private let edge: Edge
+
+    /// Sets the width of the pane. `persist` is false during a live resize.
+    private let setWidth: (CGFloat, Bool) -> Void
+
+    /// Resets the width of the pane to its default.
+    private let resetWidth: () -> Void
+
+    /// The width of the pane when the drag started.
+    private var startWidth: CGFloat = 0
+
+    /// The mouse location (in window coordinates) when the drag started.
+    private var startX: CGFloat = 0
+
+    /// True once the mouse moved after mouse down, so plain clicks don't change the width.
+    private var didDrag = false
+
+    /// A handle that resizes the tab sidebar.
+    convenience init() {
+        self.init(
+            edge: .trailing,
+            setWidth: { TabSidebarSettings.shared.setWidth($0, persist: $1) },
+            resetWidth: { TabSidebarSettings.shared.setWidth(TabSidebarLogic.defaultWidth, persist: true) })
+    }
+
+    init(edge: Edge, setWidth: @escaping (CGFloat, Bool) -> Void, resetWidth: @escaping () -> Void) {
+        self.edge = edge
+        self.setWidth = setWidth
+        self.resetWidth = resetWidth
+        super.init(frame: .zero)
+    }
+
+    @available(*, unavailable)
+    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
+        fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented")
+    }
+
+    override var mouseDownCanMoveWindow: Bool { false }
+
+    override func resetCursorRects() {
+        addCursorRect(bounds, cursor: .resizeLeftRight)
+    }
+
+    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
+        // Double click resets the width to the default.
+        if event.clickCount == 2 {
+            resetWidth()
+            return
+        }
+
+        startWidth = superview?.bounds.width ?? 0
+        startX = event.locationInWindow.x
+        didDrag = false
+    }
+
+    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
+        didDrag = true
+        NSCursor.resizeLeftRight.set()
+        setWidth(width(for: event), false)
+    }
+
+    override func mouseUp(with event: NSEvent) {
+        guard didDrag else { return }
+        didDrag = false
+        setWidth(width(for: event), true)
+    }
+
+    private func width(for event: NSEvent) -> CGFloat {
+        let delta = event.locationInWindow.x - startX
+        return startWidth + (edge == .trailing ? delta : -delta)
+    }

+    override func viewDidMoveToWindow() {
+        super.viewDidMoveToWindow()

+        guard window != nil else {
+            refreshTimer?.invalidate()
+            refreshTimer = nil
+            windowsObservation?.invalidate()

+    private func startRefreshTimer() {
+        guard refreshTimer == nil else { return }
+        let timer = Timer(timeInterval: Self.refreshInterval, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
+            self?.refreshChangedRows()
+        }
+        timer.tolerance = Self.refreshInterval / 2
+        RunLoop.main.add(timer, forMode: .common)
+        refreshTimer = timer
+    }

+    /// Reconfigures the visible rows whose content changed, e.g. because an agent
+    /// started or exited. Hidden sidebars and windows are skipped.
+    private func refreshChangedRows() {
+        guard !isHiddenOrHasHiddenAncestor, !scrollView.isHidden, let window, window.isVisible,
+              window.occlusionState.contains(.visible) else { return }
+
+        let visible = tableView.rows(in: tableView.visibleRect)
+        guard visible.length > 0 else { return }
+        for row in visible.location..<(visible.location + visible.length) {
+            guard let tab = tabs[safe: row]?.value,
+                  let rowView = tableView.rowView(atRow: row, makeIfNecessary: false) as? TabSidebarRowView else { continue }
+            if rowView.content != content(for: tab) { configure(row: row) }
+        }
+    }

+    /// Rebuilds the list of tabs from the tab group.
+    ///
+    /// Accessing `tabGroup` on a window that was never shown materializes AppKit's tab
+    /// machinery which is slow (~15-20ms), so we only do it once the window has been
+    /// visible unless the caller knows the window already belongs to a tab group. Note
+    /// that background tabs are ordered out, so we must remember this.
+    func reloadStructure(includingTabGroup: Bool = false) {
+        guard let hostWindow = window else { return }
+
+        if includingTabGroup || hostWindow.isVisible { canAccessTabGroup = true }
+        let useTabGroup = canAccessTabGroup
+        let windows: [NSWindow] = useTabGroup ? (hostWindow.tabbedWindows ?? [hostWindow]) : [hostWindow]
+        let controllers = windows.compactMap { $0.windowController as? TerminalController }
+
+        allTabs = controllers.map { Weak($0) }
+        applySearch()
+
+        if useTabGroup {
+            rebindTabGroupIfNeeded()
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Observe the tab group of our window. The group can change (e.g. "Move Tab to
+    /// New Window") so we check every time we reload.
+    private func rebindTabGroupIfNeeded() {
+        // Never replace a KVO observation from within its own callback.
+        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
+            guard let self, let hostWindow = self.window else { return }
+            let tabGroup = hostWindow.tabGroup
+            guard tabGroup !== self.observedTabGroup || self.windowsObservation == nil else { return }
+
+            self.windowsObservation?.invalidate()
+            self.windowsObservation = nil
+            self.observedTabGroup = tabGroup
+            guard let tabGroup else { return }
+
+            self.windowsObservation = tabGroup.observe(\.windows, options: [.new]) { [weak self] _, _ in
+                DispatchQueue.main.async {
+                    self?.reloadStructure()
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Updates the shown tabs from all tabs and the search field. The table is only
+    /// reloaded if the shown tabs changed.
+    private func applySearch() {
+        let terms = searchTerms
+        let shown = terms.isEmpty ? allTabs : allTabs.filter { tab in
+            guard let tab = tab.value else { return false }
+            return Self.tab(tab, matches: terms)
+        }
+
+        let oldIdentities = tabs.map { $0.value.map(ObjectIdentifier.init) }
+        let newIdentities = shown.map { $0.value.map(ObjectIdentifier.init) }
+        guard oldIdentities != newIdentities else {
+            reconfigureVisibleRows()
+            return
+        }
+
+        finishEditing(commit: true)
+        tabs = shown
+        tableView.reloadData()
+
+        if isSearching {
+            searchHighlightRow = tabs.isEmpty ? nil : min(searchHighlightRow ?? 0, tabs.count - 1)
+            updateSearchHighlight()
+        } else if let current = tabs.firstIndex(where: { $0.value === controller }) {
+            tableView.scrollRowToVisible(current)
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Whether every search term is in the title, working directory or agent of a tab.
+    private static func tab(_ tab: TerminalController, matches terms: [String]) -> Bool {
+        let pwd = tab.focusedSurface?.pwd
+        let agent = tab.focusedSurface?.surfaceModel?.foregroundPID.flatMap(TabSidebarAgent.detect(pid:))
+        let haystack = [
+            tab.window?.title,
+            tab.titleOverride,
+            pwd,
+            TabSidebarLogic.abbreviatePath(pwd),
+            agent?.displayName,
+        ]
+            .compactMap { $0?.lowercased() }
+            .joined(separator: "\n")
+        return terms.allSatisfy { haystack.contains($0) }
+    }
+
+    private func scheduleContentReload() {
+        guard !pendingContentReload else { return }
+        pendingContentReload = true
+        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
+            guard let self else { return }
+            self.pendingContentReload = false
+            if self.isSearching {
+                self.applySearch()
+            } else {
+                self.reconfigureVisibleRows()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// The content of the row of a tab. The shortcut hint is based on the position of
+    /// the tab in the tab group, not in the (possibly filtered) list.
+    private func content(for tab: TerminalController) -> TabSidebarRowContent {
+        let index = allTabs.firstIndex { $0.value === tab } ?? 0
+        return TabSidebarRowContent(controller: tab, index: index, isCurrent: tab === controller)
+    }
+
+    private func reconfigureVisibleRows() {
+        let visible = tableView.rows(in: tableView.visibleRect)
+        guard visible.length > 0 else { return }
+        for row in visible.location..<(visible.location + visible.length) {
+            configure(row: row)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func configure(row: Int) {
+        guard let tab = tabs[safe: row]?.value else { return }
+        let content = content(for: tab)
+
+        let rowView = tableView.rowView(atRow: row, makeIfNecessary: false) as? TabSidebarRowView
+        rowView?.content = content
+
+        if let cell = tableView.view(atColumn: 0, row: row, makeIfNecessary: false) as? TabSidebarCellView {
+            configure(cell: cell, tab: tab, content: content, hovered: rowView?.isHovered ?? false)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func configure(
+        cell: TabSidebarCellView,
+        tab: TerminalController,
+        content: TabSidebarRowContent,
+        hovered: Bool
+    ) {
+        cell.isEditingTitle = editingController === tab && editingField === cell.titleField
+        cell.configure(with: content)
+        cell.isHovered = hovered
+        cell.onClose = { [weak self, weak tab] in
+            guard let self, let tab else { return }
+            self.closeTab(tab)
+        }
+        cell.onResetZoom = { [weak tab] in
+            guard let tab else { return }
+            tab.splitZoom(tab)
+        }
+    }

+    /// Keep the scroll position of all sidebars in the tab group identical so switching
+    /// tabs doesn't make the list jump.
+    @objc private func onScrollBoundsDidChange(_ notification: Notification) {
+        guard !Self.isSyncingScroll, !isSearching, window?.isKeyWindow ?? false else { return }
+        Self.isSyncingScroll = true
+        defer { Self.isSyncingScroll = false }
+
+        let origin = scrollView.contentView.bounds.origin
+        for tab in allTabs {
+            guard let other = tab.value, other !== controller,
+                  let sidebar = other.terminalViewContainer?.tabSidebar else { continue }
+            sidebar.scrollView.contentView.scroll(to: origin)
+            sidebar.scrollView.reflectScrolledClipView(sidebar.scrollView.contentView)
+        }
+    }

+    @objc private func newTabClicked(_ sender: Any?) {

+    @objc private func rowClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
+        let row = tableView.clickedRow
+        guard let target = tabs[safe: row]?.value else { return }
+        let now = ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime
+
+        if isSearching {
+            lastSearchResultClick = now
+            select(target)
+            return
+        }
+
+        // Clicking the current tab: if this is the second click of a double click
+        // that started in another tab's sidebar, start renaming.
+        if target === controller {
+            if let last = Self.lastSwitchClick,
+               last.tab == ObjectIdentifier(target),
+               now - last.time <= NSEvent.doubleClickInterval {
+                Self.lastSwitchClick = nil
+                beginRename(for: target)
+                return
+            }
+
+            restoreTerminalFocus()
+            return
+        }
+
+        Self.lastSwitchClick = (ObjectIdentifier(target), now)
+        target.window?.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
+    }
+
+    @objc private func rowDoubleClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
+        let now = ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime
+        guard now - lastSearchResultClick > NSEvent.doubleClickInterval else { return }
+        let row = tableView.clickedRow
+        guard let target = tabs[safe: row]?.value else { return }
+        Self.lastSwitchClick = nil
+
+        // The double click may come in before the window switch completes.
+        if target !== controller {
+            target.window?.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
+            target.terminalViewContainer?.tabSidebar?.beginRename(for: target)
+            return
+        }
+
+        beginRename(for: target)
+    }

+    /// Close a tab, confirming if necessary. The confirmation sheet is attached to the

+            target.window?.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
+        }
+
+        target.closeTab(nil)
+    }

+    // MARK: Inline Rename
+
+    /// Starts inline editing of the title of the given tab. Returns false if the
+    /// sidebar can't edit it (e.g. the sidebar is hidden).
+    @discardableResult
+    func beginRename(for target: TerminalController) -> Bool {
+        guard TabSidebarSettings.shared.isVisible, !isHidden,
+              let window, window.isVisible else { return false }
+
+        // Make sure our list is current, the target may have just been created.
+        if isSearching { clearSearch() }
+        reloadStructure()
+        guard let row = tabs.firstIndex(where: { $0.value === target }) else { return false }
+
+        // Already editing this tab.
+        if editingController === target, editingField != nil { return true }
+        finishEditing(commit: true)
+
+        tableView.scrollRowToVisible(row)
+        guard let cell = tableView.view(atColumn: 0, row: row, makeIfNecessary: true) as? TabSidebarCellView else {
+            return false
+        }
+
+        let field = cell.titleField
+        editingController = target
+        editingField = field
+        cell.isEditingTitle = true
+
+        field.stringValue = target.titleOverride ?? target.window?.title ?? ""
+        field.isEditable = true
+        field.isSelectable = true
+        field.drawsBackground = true
+        field.backgroundColor = .textBackgroundColor
+        field.textColor = .labelColor
+        field.focusRingType = .none
+        field.lineBreakMode = .byClipping
+        field.cell?.truncatesLastVisibleLine = false
+        field.cell?.usesSingleLineMode = true
+        field.cell?.isScrollable = true
+        field.cell?.wraps = false
